# Zizeg

> Preview and Source. Both editable. Zizeg is a native macOS Markdown editor for working visually, directly in Markdown, or with both editors side by side.

Zizeg edits ordinary `.md` files directly on disk. Its rendered Preview and Markdown Source are equal editing surfaces: users can edit either one separately or keep both visible in Split view, where changes stay synchronized. The same toolbar, menus, and keyboard shortcuts work in both editors. Preview and Source can also use independent typography and independent or synchronized scrolling.

Zizeg follows native macOS document conventions, including standard document tabs, menus, toolbar controls, autosave, and Finder-based files. It does not require a vault, library, import step, proprietary database, or proprietary document format.

Language availability: English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish (Spain), and Spanish (Mexico). Choose the app interface language in Zizeg Preferences; the built-in Help follows the Mac language setting.

The app is designed for everyday Markdown work, including READMEs, instruction files, specifications, plans, changelogs, and summaries created during AI-assisted workflows. Zizeg itself does not use AI or send documents to an AI service.

Safety checks do not silently rewrite the saved Markdown. Sanitization happens during rendering and export, remote images remain blocked until the user approves them, and unsafe or unsupported content is visibly flagged. Pasted images can be stored in a sibling assets folder or embedded for single-file portability. Zizeg can export self-contained HTML and multi-page PDF.

Markdown support covers CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown, including headings, lists, task lists, tables, strikethrough, autolinks, code, quotes, links, and images. It does not currently include math/LaTeX, footnotes, or Mermaid diagrams.

## Availability and pricing

Zizeg is available now on the Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zizeg/id6800761262?mt=12. Opening and viewing Markdown is free. Editing and export can be unlocked with a USD lifetime purchase of $14.99, a 12-month subscription of $9.99, or a 3-month subscription of $2.99. Both subscriptions include a 7-day free trial. Final App Store prices vary by region.

App Store availability updated: 2026-09-23. Other product details last reviewed: 2026-09-05. Guides updated: 2026-10-21.

- [Change the Default Markdown App on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/change-default-markdown-app-mac/): Markdown files opening in Xcode or TextEdit? Change the default app for .md files on Mac in Finder, or with one click in Zizeg’s preferences.
- [Edit Markdown Without a Vault or Workspace](https://zizeg.app/guides/edit-markdown-without-vault/): Edit a Markdown file where it already lives: no vault, workspace or import. Zizeg opens the .md in place and autosaves your changes.
- [Editable Markdown Preview vs Split Preview](https://zizeg.app/guides/editable-markdown-preview-vs-split-view/): Editable Markdown preview or split preview? See the difference, and how Zizeg lets you edit both the formatted Preview and the Source side by side.
- [A Native Mac Alternative to Typora](https://zizeg.app/guides/native-mac-typora-alternative/): Looking for a native Mac alternative to Typora? Try Zizeg: editable Preview and Source side by side, plain files, and a Lifetime Unlock option.
- [Edit Markdown Tables Visually on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/edit-markdown-tables-visually/): Edit Markdown tables without counting pipes. Change cells, rows and columns in Zizeg’s editable Preview while the file stays ordinary Markdown.
- [Export Markdown to PDF on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-to-pdf-mac/): Export Markdown to PDF on Mac. Pick the paper size, choose which images to include, and send a clean, paginated copy made with Zizeg.
- [Export Markdown as Standalone HTML on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-to-standalone-html/): Export Markdown as one standalone HTML file with its images embedded. Send a browser-readable copy from Zizeg and keep your .md for editing.
- [Share Markdown, PDF or HTML — Which Should You Send?](https://zizeg.app/guides/share-markdown-pdf-or-html/): Should you send Markdown, PDF or HTML? Choose the right format for editing, printing or browser reading, and export the copy from Zizeg.
- [Fix Missing Markdown Images After Moving a File](https://zizeg.app/guides/fix-markdown-images-after-moving-file/): Markdown images missing after moving the file? Put the image folder back, fix the relative path, or pick a replacement picture in Zizeg.
- [Add Screenshots and Images to Markdown on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/add-screenshots-to-markdown-mac/): Add screenshots and images to Markdown on Mac: paste, drag or insert a picture in Zizeg, which stores it beside your file and writes the reference for you.
- [Markdown Images: Separate Files or Base64?](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-images-files-vs-base64/): Markdown images as separate files or Base64? Compare readability, file size and portability, then convert a copy with Zizeg’s Save As.
- [Remote Markdown Images Not Loading? What to Check](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-remote-images-not-loading/): Online images missing from your Markdown preview? Tell a blocked image from a broken link, load it in Zizeg, and check what your export includes.
- [What Is YAML Front Matter in Markdown?](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-yaml-front-matter/): What is the YAML block at the top of a Markdown file? Learn what front matter does, edit it in Zizeg’s Source, and keep it out of exports.
- [Edit Markdown Without Unnecessary Reformatting](https://zizeg.app/guides/edit-markdown-without-reformatting/): Edit Markdown without reformatting the rest of your file. Zizeg changes what you edit, keeps your content, and gives you Source for exact syntax.
- [Why Markdown Looks Different Between Apps](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-looks-different-between-apps/): Markdown looks different in another app? Check styling, supported syntax and changed text, with Source beside Preview in Zizeg.
- [Review and Edit AI-Generated Markdown on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/review-ai-generated-markdown/): Review AI-generated Markdown plans and reports on Mac. Read the draft in Zizeg, check the facts, and fix text, tables and checklists directly.
- [Create and Edit Markdown Checklists on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-checklist-mac/): Create a Markdown checklist on Mac with - [ ] and - [x]. Tick tasks in Zizeg’s Preview, and the checked state stays in your plain .md file.
- [Navigate Long Markdown Documents on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/navigate-long-markdown-document/): Navigate a long Markdown document on Mac. Jump between headings with Zizeg’s table of contents, search with Find, and show Source row numbers.

- [Large Markdown Files Slow? What to Try on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/large-markdown-files-slow/): Large Markdown file slow to open? See what makes it heavy, edit in Zizeg’s Source while Preview loads, and slim down embedded images.
- [Markdown File Changed in Another App? Reload or Keep](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-file-changed-another-app/): Markdown file changed by another app or an AI agent? Choose Reload or Keep My Version in Zizeg, and keep a copy when both versions matter.
- [What Is an .md File? Markdown Explained](https://zizeg.app/guides/what-is-an-md-file/): What is an .md file? Markdown is plain text with simple formatting marks. Read its headings, lists and tables in Zizeg on your Mac.
- [Markdown Line Breaks: New Line or New Paragraph?](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-line-breaks/): Markdown line break not showing? See new lines, paragraphs and explicit breaks clearly, with Source and Preview side by side in Zizeg.
- [Markdown Table Alignment: Left, Center or Right](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-table-alignment/): Markdown table alignment explained: use :--- for left, :---: for center and ---: for right, or set a column’s alignment with one click in Zizeg.
